definitions.explanation: Being released from a hospital after treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{退院|たいいん}⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can leave the hospital next week.

examples.japanese: {退院|たいいん}⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧。
⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あと→後：09580_ato⟧{二週間|にしゅうかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{退院|たいいん}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：01288_anshin⟧。
examples.english: I was relieved to hear that I could leave the hospital two weeks after the surgery.

notes:
{退院|たいいん} means being discharged from a hospital after treatment or recovery.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {退院|たいいん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

ETYMOLOGY:
{退|たい} (withdraw/leave) + {院|いん} (institution/hospital).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {退院|たいいん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be discharged, to leave the hospital
- {退院|たいいん}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be able to leave the hospital
- {退院|たいいん}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧: discharge date
- {退院|たいいん}⟦{届|とど}け→届け：07558_todoke⟧: discharge notification form
- {退院|たいいん}⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧: Congratulations on your discharge!

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧: hospitalization (entering the hospital)
- ⟦{通院|つういん}→通院：05975_tsuuin⟧: outpatient visits (going to hospital without staying)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, it's common to visit someone who has {退院|たいいん} with a gift (⟦{快気祝|かいきいわ}い→快気祝い：08663_kaikiiwai⟧) to celebrate their recovery. The patient may also give thank-you gifts (⟦{快気内祝|かいきうちいわ}い→快気内祝い：29136_kaikiuchiiwai⟧) to those who visited during their stay.
